findings.evidence: Figure captions use a free-form second token: "[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]" (Figs 2.1, 2.2, 4.1, 5.1, 6.1) and "[ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic profile]" (Fig 6.2), whereas Figs 1.1, 3.4 and 7.1 use the canonical pair form "[ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED]". The Preface axis note (PDF p. 19) closes the vocabulary: "measurement status therefore uses ANALYTICAL, SCENARIO-DERIVED, MODELED, MEASURED or UNMEASURED", and Axis-2 is limited to FACT/DERIVED/ASSUMPTION/HYPOTHESIS/UNRESOLVED.
findings.issue: Inconsistent caption labeling practice: "conceptual" and "synthetic profile" are second tokens belonging to neither the Axis-2 epistemic set nor the Axis-3 measurement set, so captions carrying the same kind of tag are formatted three different ways across the book (pair form, free-form, and untagged prose qualifiers as in Figs 3.1/3.2).
findings.fix_instruction: Standardize all figure provenance tags to the defined vocabulary: use the pair form (e.g. [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] for schematic figures, matching Figs 1.1/3.4/7.1) or move the "conceptual"/"synthetic" qualifier into the caption prose outside the bracketed tag; apply the same form to Figs 2.1, 2.2, 4.1, 5.1, 6.1 and 6.2 and audit the remaining 20+ captions.
